patient_profile.diagnosis_summary: Adult female with chronic kidney disease stage 4 secondary to autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD), plus diabetes, hypertension, hypothyroidism, and hyperlipidemia.

request.requested_disposition: Coverage approval for Jynarque to slow ADPKD progression

denial_rationale: Insurer denied Jynarque, stating the submitted records did not meet medical necessity criteria for use.

known_facts.text: Patient has CKD stage 4 secondary to ADPKD, with comorbid diabetes, hypertension, hypothyroidism, and hyperlipidemia.
CT abdomen/pelvis showed right kidney 12.6 x 4.4 x 7.9 cm and left kidney 6.5 x 5.8 x 12.2 cm.
Renal volume was not quantified in the submitted imaging report.
Patient height was not provided in the submitted records.

treatment_or_claim_history.description: CT abdomen/pelvis performed showing bilateral kidney enlargement consistent with ADPKD.
Provider requested Jynarque to slow progression of kidney disease.

available_evidence.description: CT abdomen/pelvis report with kidney measurements
Patient height (needed for Mayo Clinic height-adjusted total kidney volume classification)

unknowns: Patient's height, needed to compute the height-adjusted Mayo Clinic ADPKD risk class.
Rate of eGFR decline over time (used to independently assess rapid progression).
